resources.string: On Android 11+, connect to Wi-Fi, enable Developer options and Wireless debugging, then choose Pair device with pairing code. Enter that code in the ForgeMind notification. A computer, root and a separate Shizuku app are not required. Some manufacturer settings still need manual confirmation.
Pairing saved. Connect to verify access.
Connection not confirmed. Check Wireless debugging and its current port, then retry.
Permissions checked. Items still disabled can be configured using Android settings below.
Open Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code. Waiting for the local pairing service…
Keep the pairing dialog open in split-screen. Its port is different from the connection port on the main Wireless debugging screen.
Enter a valid port and a six-digit pairing code.
Installs the bundled ForgeMind helper in its own folder in Termux. Missing Python and tmux may require a download. Existing servers and passwords are preserved.
Termux connected. Live terminal, commands and files are available.
Termux connection not confirmed. Check command access and allow-external-apps, then retry.
